summary: Two robots wander a dead world hand in hand. Tap to follow a cozy, wordless tale
description:
■ Hand in hand, let's walk as far as we can.

In a world where civilization has ended and no one is left,
two robots hold hands and walk on, ever onward, across an empty wasteland.
What you do is simple.
Pick up the trash lying around, gently pet a buddy whose heart has broken,
and hunt the "wild microwaves" that turn up now and then, as the quiet journey goes on.

There are no lines of dialogue.
And so the story comes to life, quietly, only within your own heart.

■ Features

[1] Just tap. A simple post-apocalyptic stroll
No difficult controls at all. Tap the screen, walk, and pick things up.
A calm, atmospheric game for wandering the wasteland in your spare moments.

[2] A wordless story that stays with you
The characters never speak a single word.
The "Memories" you collect gradually light up the story of this dying world.
Why are the two of them traveling? Who is the "Executioner" blocking their path?
And what waits at their destination—?

[3] Quiet, gentle, and strangely addictive
No flashy effects, no timers rushing you.
And yet you can't help wondering about the next step.
Soak in a gentle post-apocalyptic world that's funny and a little bittersweet.

■ Things to do
・Collect "Memories" to unravel the story of the dying world
・Pet your downhearted buddy to draw out all kinds of reactions
・Hunt the wild microwaves

■ Recommended for
・Anyone who loves atmospheric games or quiet walking games
・Anyone who loves wordless stories and novels you fill in with imagination
・Anyone who loves post-apocalyptic, dystopian sci-fi worlds
・Anyone after a heartwarming story that's funny and a little sad
・Anyone who wants to play all the way through without spending money

Free to play to the end (contains ads; optional in-app purchases).
Optional purchases: Ad Off Plus / Sunset Skies / Donation.

Our titles share a world, but there's no story connection between them.
You can enjoy this one no matter which title you start from.

So take their hand.
Let's walk a quiet apocalypse, as far as we can go.
